## Technical Requirements

- Rhino 8.0 or above is required
- Windows 10/11 or macOS
- Valid API keys for MistralAI, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Gemini, or a self-hosted LocalAI/Ollama endpoint

## Important Notes

- This is a development release - NOT READY FOR PRODUCTION USE
- Files may be corrupted or incompatible with future versions
- External AI providers may charge usage costs
- Documentation is currently under development
